verification.short_circuit: Within each trajectory, decide after two agreeing outcomes (2 of K=3). Across trajectories, KEEP at the first trajectory reaching the target in at least 2/3 reruns.
verification.support_order: A deterministic uniform sample of at most five same-rubric trajectories, without replacement.
verification.target: Each member's own feedback behavioral locus and member-specific intervention; Stage-1 Applicable required, No Match proceeds to the next assigned trajectory.
verification.keep: KEEP immediately when any sampled applicable trajectory reaches the requested outcome change in at least 2/3 reruns; otherwise NOT_VALIDATED after at most five valid trajectories or candidate exhaustion.

notes.consolidation: Success and failure strata are independent. The first trajectory in each non-empty stratum always generates. Gemini compares each later group of at most eight trajectories both with the current valid bank and with one another. One representative per proposed same-reason peer group generates; peers are rechecked against the actual generated rubric before reuse.
notes.generation_savings: A matched trajectory reuses the unchanged rubric and skips rubric generation and Gate. Matching is performed by the configured rubric-generator model; topic or label similarity alone is insufficient because all matcher checks must pass.
notes.verification: Sample at most five same-rubric trajectories. Each gets up to three reruns with early 2-of-3 decision; KEEP at the first passing trajectory.
notes.unchanged: Agent, Doctor, Gate, scorer, prompts, rollout tree, reward, optimizer, schedule, cumulative scoring scope, and checkpoint behavior are inherited unchanged from train120_max4_direct_luna_v9_1.json. Rubric generation and both bank/peer consolidation matching use Gemini through OpenRouter.
notes.evaluation: Independent training-priority idle evaluators process all 622 pinned cases for C30, C60, C90, and C120. Training inference and updates have priority.
notes.gate_runtime: Gate output limit is 16384 to prevent the observed direct-OpenAI length truncation; technical truncation remains an execution error, never a score.
